intro.text: A lighthouse at the tip of a peninsula in Shadesmar, where Riino reads the future for passing travelers.

description.text: It serves as a waypoint where passing ships can restock, and its light tells them that land is near.
The lighthouse is a large stone tower crowned by a huge bonfire. The fire gives off no heat and, unlike Shadesmar's sun, casts shadows away from itself.
Inside it is sparsely furnished, with paintings on some walls, a ship manifest listing when supplies are due, and stores of food and goods available in exchange for infused spheres.

A second room, built against the tower's base and reached from inside, is where Riino gives readings. It has large windows, more paintings, incense and strong spices, and a table holding a big crystal globe filled with a bright substance. A reading costs two marks' worth of Stormlight, and during a highstorm the globe shifts to mimic the storm's light.

items.text: After escaping Kholinar into Shadesmar in 1174, Azure, Adolin, Shallan, Kaladin and their spren happened upon the lighthouse. Riino caught Kaladin scouting and, taking him for a customer, welcomed him in; as a highstorm passed, Kaladin accidentally saw a vision through the globe. The group then traded with Riino for food and provisions until the next supply ship was due.
